title: Secretary’s Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office celebrates Secretary's Day with various gestures and jokes, leading to humorous interactions, conflicts, and revelations among the staff, including Michael planning a lunch with Erin, and tensions arising from office suspensions and Angela's confrontation with Erin.
